author: JerryRigEverything
description:
The LG Rollable was *never* supposed to see the real world. But here we are.  Come touch grass HERE: https://www.dbrand.com/touchgrass it feels *amazing*. The LG Rollable was supposed to be released back in 2021. But then LG decided to shut down their mobile smartphone division - and the LG Rollable got buried.   Then I came along with a shovel. 

Lets open up the LG Rollable and see how it works from the inside. 
You can get my smartphone toolkit HERE: https://www.ifixit.com/Jerryrig
title: I'm not supposed to have this...
